## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. Market shows narrow strength in Energy while broad indices are weak — SPY (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -4.29%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND and VXX (1W: -1.60% | 1M: +29.42%) ↓ falling / CORRECTION confirm mixed, indeterminate backdrop.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Commodity-driven risk: USO (1W: +10.22% | 1M: +51.97%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +11.58% | 1M: +49.06%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND pushing energy as a focal point. Credit and vol remain mixed: HYG (1W: -0.61% | 1M: -1.54%) → flat | BELOW TREND and LQD (1W: -1.81% | 1M: -1.95%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND show fragile credit tone while VXX divergence signals lingering vol risk.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral overall: SPY/TLT flagged NEUTRAL while TLT (1W: -2.17% | 1M: -1.40%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND implies higher yields tightening conditions modestly; dollar moves are neutral in the data.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Energy leading: XLE (1W: +2.00% | 1M: +4.95%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND. Tech lagging: XLK (1W: -0.36% | 1M: -4.32%) → flat | BELOW TREND. Style: mixed / no clear leadership given weak breadth across cyclicals and defensives.

5. US vs Global?
US soft: SPY (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -4.29%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND. China showing short-term bounce: FXI (1W: +1.17% | 1M: -8.18%) ↑ rising | RECOVERY while EM EEM (1W: -0.91% | 1M: -7.73%) → flat | BELOW TREND.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Crypto/speculation bifurcated: IBIT (1W: +4.59% | 1M: +5.43%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND, while small cap IWM (1W: -1.71% | 1M: -6.93%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND and ARKK (1W: -2.97% | 1M: -0.87%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND show risk appetite uneven.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Oil and broad commodities strong: USO (1W: +10.22% | 1M: +51.97%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND, PDBC (1W: +4.58% | 1M: +18.22%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND. Metals weak: CPER (1W: -2.27% | 1M: -5.38%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND and GLD (1W: -2.68% | 1M: -1.45%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND show risk-off flows into select real assets.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy clear leadership: XLE (1W: +2.00% | 1M: +4.95%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +11.58% | 1M: +49.06%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND; natural gas mixed: UNG (1W: -0.86% | 1M: +2.60%) → flat | CORRECTION.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: Energy (XLE) ABOVE TREND and broad commodity ETFs (USO/BNO) ABOVE TREND. DIVERGENCE: VXX (1W: -1.60% | 1M: +29.42%) CORRECTION, FXI (1W: +1.17% | 1M: -8.18%) RECOVERY and several 1W vs 1M mismatches are MINOR divergences but keep the regime muted.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor exposure to energy/commodity-linked ETFs (XLE, USO); reduce exposure to broadly correlated US beta given SPY (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -4.29%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND and small caps IWM (1W: -1.71% | 1M: -6.93%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND. Bonds and credit show mixed signals — monitor HYG (1W: -0.61% | 1M: -1.54%) → flat | BELOW TREND and LQD (1W: -1.81% | 1M: -1.95%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Energy — XLE (1W: +2.00% | 1M: +4.95%) ABOVE TREND if oil momentum continues. BEARISH: Broad US cyclicals/discretionary and financials given weak breadth — watch SPY (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -4.29%) BELOW TREND for downside continuation.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Oil ETFs USO (1W: +10.22% | 1M: +51.97%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +11.58% | 1M: +49.06%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Industrial metals/copper CPER (1W: -2.27% | 1M: -5.38%) BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?
VXX 20 (vol complacency threshold), HYG/LQD 0.80 (credit health barometer), XLK/XLF ratio (growth vs value pivot) — watch these as triggers for regime tilt.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. Energy (XLE, USO/BNO) showing relative strength while broad US equity indices (SPY) and small caps (IWM) show weakness. Key risk is the divergence in volatility and commodities—VXX (1W: -1.60% | 1M: +29.42%) CORRECTION and persistent 1W vs 1M mismatches that can tip the market from neutral into rotation or risk-off.
